🚨 Cloud Security Alert

Railway says attackers may have accessed encrypted customer environment variables—and decrypted some secrets.

The platform is urging all users to revoke and rotate API and cloud keys.

Lesson: Treat exposed secrets as compromised and rotate credentials.
